visualCharacteristics: Text-only link tiles, centred, 3 per row on desktop (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile)

contentPattern.structure: One link per row (or per cell); each link becomes one centred tile

usage.description: Related Pages list of text links at the bottom of recipe pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for a list of related links without images. Put a heading (e.g. 'Related Pages') before the block as default content; one link per row.
